rows.note: For physical side-to-side width, 闊 is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.english: This table is wide enough for three people to eat together.
example.traditional: 呢張枱夠闊，三個人一齊食飯都得。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 gau3 fut3 saam1 go3 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 dou1 dak1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for “completely,” as in 完全清醒 for “wide awake.”

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jyun4 cyun4 cing1 sing2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for going or spreading all over a place, as in travelling 周圍.

example.english: We’ve travelled wide and been to lots of places in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 我哋周圍去過香港好多地方。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zau1 wai4 heoi3 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1

rows.note: Use 廣 when the breadth refers to a scope, range, or remit rather than physical width.

example.english: This plan covers a wide range of areas.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃涵蓋嘅範圍好廣。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 haam4 koi3 ge3 faan6 wai4 hou2 gwong2

rows.note: Use this construction with an opening verb when something is opened to its greatest width.

example.english: Open the door wide so the goods can be carried in.
example.traditional: 將道門開到最大，等啲貨搬入嚟。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 dou6 mun4 hoi1 dou3 zeoi3 daai6 dang2 di1 fo3 bun1 jap6 lei4
